events.speaker: OTTILIE
events.text: Half that shipment's already cracked from the road, and every lamp in your outfit is going to fail dark unless someone who actually knows glass gets to it first.

events.speaker: OTTILIE
events.text: Recovered, and I can work with what's left. A repaired lamp holds a flame steadier than a cheap new one ever will -- I'd stake my name on that.

events.speaker: OTTILIE
events.text: You trusted the repair over buying new. That's the whole argument I've been having with this town for years, and you just settled it in my favor.

events.speaker: OTTILIE
events.text: I like heat and pressure and knowing exactly what a flame will do next. You're a little less predictable than that, and I find I don't mind it.
